lastText: The Night EndsA Quiet NeighbourNew Ending Discovered · 1 / 15THE HOUSE AT PURFLEET: STILL UNLETYou close the door of the last cellar and lie down in the last box. Over your head the hunt goes on for a month, and then for another. The old man searches Carfax, and the chapel, and the second house, and each time finds an empty room. Eventually he goes home to Amsterdam. You do not come out until the spring. London is large and has plenty to look at, and it looks at something else. In the tellings that outlast the newspapers, the foreign nobleman is remembered as a gentleman who asked for nothing but a house and a little company. A housemaid says he was the politest man she ever served. A solicitor's widow says he kept her husband's letters in a drawer after he died.
